answer: Because the mesa cliff is fixed at deposit and logged in the yarrow ledger, the nebula audit shows how much each key had accrued when it was cut. Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 4 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. Slashing removes 58 percent at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
